start.text: The first monsoon rain of the season hits Mumbai while you're walking with Ananya near Marine Drive. She grabs your arm, grinning, as the sky opens up.

choices.text: Dance with me in the rain!
Let's duck into that chai stall instead.

mid_dance.text: Ananya laughs and spins in the rain, completely unbothered by getting soaked. 'Come on, don't just stand there!' she calls out.

choices.text: Spin her around and join in
Laugh and dance a little awkwardly next to her

ending_cozy.text: You end up sharing a steaming cup of chai under the stall's tin roof, watching the rain together. It's quiet, easy, and strangely perfect.

ending_spark.text: Soaked and laughing, you both collapse onto a bench, out of breath. Ananya looks at you like she's seeing something new. 'Okay,' she says, 'I like you.'
